admin-usage.alt: Admin › Usage in Open Model Gateway: spend for the month with the amount on hold and a link to requests with unknown cost, requests and tokens, the installation's monthly budget, and spend per day.
admin-usage.caption: Costs are counted in exact micro-dollars and shown rounded, with the exact amount on hover. Holds and unknown costs are shown as such, never as zero.

admin-limits.alt: Admin › Settings › Defaults & limits, Team default: requests and tokens per minute, requests at once, jobs at once, storage and a monthly budget, with tabs for the installation ceiling and the Personal and Project defaults.
admin-limits.caption: Budgets and limits stack: installation, workspace type, workspace and key. Every layer that applies is enforced.

workspace-models.alt: Workspace › Models: the models this workspace can use, each with its API name, type, serving state and configured prices, two of them ticked for comparison.
workspace-models.caption: Each workspace sees the models its catalogs and direct assignments allow, and nothing else.

workspace-keys.alt: Workspace › API keys: the workspace's keys with their holder, models, expiry and last use, and a risk badge on keys the key safety audit flagged.
workspace-keys.caption: Keys belong to one workspace, carry their own limits and models, and are shown once.

workspace-logs.alt: Workspace › Logs › Requests: summary figures for the period above a list of requests with time, model, key and app, tokens, cost, latency, time to first token and speed.
workspace-logs.caption: Logs keep request metadata: model, status, tokens, timing and cost. Never prompts or responses.

admin-connections.alt: Admin › Connections: provider connections for OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter and an approved self-hosted vLLM endpoint, each with its status.
admin-connections.caption: Connections hold credential references, never the secrets themselves. Self-hosted endpoints need server-side approval.

admin-key-safety.alt: Admin › Records › Key safety: High, Medium and Low counts of Team and Project keys that need attention, a count of personal keys, and one row per flagged key with its findings and a fix.
admin-key-safety.caption: The key safety audit finds keys with no expiry, no limits, an absent holder or no recent use, and offers the fix.

batch-detail.alt: A batch page: the running batch's mode, model, key and input file, its scheduling, line outcomes, progress by line, and cost so far as a lower bound with the amount on hold.
batch-detail.caption: Batches for any model: on the provider's batch API where it has one, otherwise run line by line by the gateway.
